title: Python asyncio.gather exception cancellation shielding leak
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0834: Python asyncio.gather exception cancellation shielding leak
Repository: `python/cpython`
Category: `Asynchronous Event Loop Deadlocks`
Target File: `Lib/asyncio/tasks.py`

#### Problem Description
When one task in gather raises, cancelled sibling tasks ignore CancelledError and continue executing in background.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Propagate CancelledError recursively to all child tasks and wait for task completion before re-raising.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0834.py -q`
expected_invariant: Propagate CancelledError recursively to all child tasks and wait for task completion before re-raising.
